name: labs/little-did-i-know__scpi-instrument-control
title: Siglent SPD3303X programmable power supply
intro: Siglent SPD3303X programmable power supply, adapted from little-did-i-know/scpi-instrument-control. It reads `measured_voltage`, `measured_current`, `identity` and `last_error`; sets `voltage`, `current` and `tracking`; runs `identify`, `measure_voltage` and `measure_current`. `identify`: read the instrument identity. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
